sn35.154:1.1: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || pe || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca ||
sn35.154:1.3: kittāvatā nu kho bhante indriyasampanno hotīti || || 4
sn35.154:2.1: Cakkhundriye ce bhikkhu udayavyayānupassī viharanto cakkhundriye nibbindati || Sotindriye || Ghānindriye ||
sn35.154:2.3: Manindriye ce bhikkhu udayavyayānupassī viharanto manindriye nibbindati ||
sn35.154:2.4: nibbindaṃ virajjati || la || Vimutasmi vimuttamhīti ñānaṃ hoti ||
sn35.154:2.5: Khīnā jāti vusitam brahmacariyaṃ || kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparam itthattāyāti pajānāti || || 5
